title: पठन सिप विकासमा प्रारम्भिक कक्षा पढाइ कार्यक्रमको सान्दर्भिकता  Pathan Sip Bikasma Prarambhik Kakshya Padhai Karyakramko Sandharbhikata
nepali: यो अध्ययन राष्ट्रिय प्रारम्भिक कक्षा पढाइ कार्यक्रमको योजना र विकासमा आधारित छ । उक्त कार्यक्रमको सान्दर्भिकतालाई शैक्षिक गुणस्तर अभिवृद्धिका हिसाबले मूल्याङ्कन गर्नु नै यस अध्ययनकोउद्देश्य रहेको छ । अध्ययनलाई यस कार्यक्रमसँग सम्बन्धित आधार सामग्री, तालिम स्रोत सामग्री,मार्गदर्शनलगायत अन्य मातृभाषा विषयक द्वितीयक स्रोत सामग्रीलाई आधार मानेर गुणात्मक अध्ययनविश्लेषण गरिएको छ । विद्यार्थीको सिकाइमा केन्द्रित भई शिक्षाको गुणस्तर सुधार गर्ने मूल उद्देश्यअनुरूप नेपाल सरकार, शिक्षा मन्त्रालयले पञ्चवर्षीय कार्यक्रमको रूपमा आ.व. २०७१÷०७२ देखिआधारभूत तह (कक्षा १–३) मा यस कार्यक्रमको थालनी गरेको हो । यसले ‘बुझेर पढ्ने र पढेर बुझ्ने’मान्यताका आधारमा प्रारम्भिक तहमा पढाइ सिप राम्रो भएमा समग्र शिक्षाको जग बलियो हुन्छ भन्नेअवधारणालाई अघि सारेको छ । पठन संस्कृतिलाई व्यवस्थित विकास गर्ने गरी ६ ओटा तŒवलाईनिर्दिष्ट गरेको यस कार्यक्रममा मातृभाषा शिक्षालाई विशेष जोड दिइएको छ । यिनै विषयवस्तुकोमहत्तालाई केन्द्रमा राखेर यस अध्ययनमा प्रारम्भिक तहमा पढाइ सिप विकासको आवश्यकता, मातृभाषाशिक्षा, नीति तथा यस कार्यक्रमको व्यावहारिकता लगायतका सन्दर्भलाई विश्लेषण गरिएको छ ।
american_english: This study is based on the planning and development of the National Early Grade Reading Program. The objective of this study is to evaluate the relevance of the said program in terms of enhancing educational quality. The study was qualitatively analyzed based on foundational materials, training resource materials, guidelines, and other secondary source materials related to mother tongues associated with this program. In accordance with the main objective of improving the quality of education by focusing on student learning, the Government of Nepal, Ministry of Education initiated this program as a five-year program starting from fiscal year 2071/072 in the basic level (grades 1–3). On the premise of 'reading to understand and understanding what is read', it put forward the concept that if reading skills are strong at the early grade level, the foundation of overall education will be robust. In this program, which specifies six components to systematically develop a reading culture, special emphasis has been placed on mother-tongue education. Centering on the significance of these themes, this study analyzes aspects including the need for developing reading skills at the early grade level, mother-tongue education, policy, and the practical feasibility of this program.
british_english: This study is based on the planning and development of the National Early Grade Reading Programme. The objective of this study is to evaluate the relevance of the said programme in terms of improving educational quality. The study was qualitatively analysed on the basis of core materials, training resource materials, guidelines and other secondary resource materials concerning mother tongues associated with this programme. In accordance with the primary aim of improving educational quality by focusing on pupils' learning, the Government of Nepal, Ministry of Education launched this initiative as a five-year programme from financial year 2071/072 at the primary level (classes 1–3). On the premise of 'reading to understand and reading with comprehension', it put forward the notion that if reading skills are sound at the early grade level, the foundation of education as a whole will be strong. In this programme, which sets out six components to systematically cultivate a reading culture, particular emphasis is placed on mother-tongue education. Centering on the importance of these themes, this study analyses contexts including the necessity of developing reading skills at the early primary level, mother-tongue education, policy and the practical viability of this programme.
